scenarios.name: Use a panel expansion while a modeling command is active

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is visible with Modify unpinned
the Shell command is active with its properties and preview visible
the user opens the Modify additional-command area
the additional area opens while Shell properties and preview remain visible
the user selects a solid face for Shell
Shell remains active with one face selected and an updated preview
the user opens the Modify additional-command area again
the area opens while the Shell face selection and preview remain visible
the properties, preview and additional-command area close
